utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana — I’m still a little mixed up on the first spot, but I know I’m watching for the tool list and any updates.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’m checking the list too, and I’ll wait for the tool list and any updates before I help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know which parts still need repair for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still sorting out what tools we’re missing, so I’ll update you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — the repair drive is definitely still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on — just tell me the most urgent bit when you can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. What’s still left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details, so I’m not sure what’s left yet. If you want, I can check for the latest update and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What do you still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly extra hands, I’d say — and maybe a few tools if folks can spare them. I’ll keep you posted if the parts list changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and connect folks who want to pitch in—what time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Jules — how about Saturday morning around 10? I’ll get the tool list together so we can fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a bit foggy on the exact list, but I think it was mostly the gate and a couple of lane markers. What time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still sorting out the details, but Sunday at the community center is the plan. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I’m here now and ready to help. What parts still need repair for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — we still need help with the leaky faucet, the loose porch rail, and a few jammed cabinet doors. I’ll send the full list and Sunday’s community center details over now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Saturday morning at the community center on Maple works for me too. I’ll repeat it along if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — Saturday morning at the community center on Maple it is. If anything changes, I’ll let everyone know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still sorting the repair drive details—I’ll let you know as soon as the plan’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Leo — just let me know the time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — once the tool list comes in, I can swing by and help fill in whatever’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep the community center on Maple as the first repair drive spot and note any updates as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—send me the first stop’s tool list when you have it, and I’ll bring whatever’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the first stop’s tool list as soon as I’ve got it, and I’ll keep spreading the word too.
